title: STORM: Stepwise Token Optimization with Reward-Guided Beam Search
abstract: arXiv:2606.10621v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern retrieval increasingly relies on dense and learned-sparse neural models that are effective but require encoding the entire corpus into a specialized index, rebuilt whenever the model changes. Lexical retrievers like BM25 stay efficient and transparent on a standard inverted index that need not change as models evolve, but suffer from vocabulary mismatch. LLM query rewriting can help, yet prompted rewriters emit well-formed but retrieval-ineffective or harmful-terms, and training against a retrieval reward gives only delayed, sequence-level supervision that obscures which terms helped. translated_title: STORM：基于奖励引导的束搜索逐步令牌优化
translated_abstract: 现代检索越来越依赖密集和学习的稀疏神经模型，这些模型有效但需要将整个语料库编码为专用索引，并在模型变化时重建。像BM25这样的词汇检索器在标准倒排索引上保持高效和透明，无需随模型演化而变化，但存在词汇不匹配问题。LLM查询重写可以有所帮助，但提示式重写器生成形式良好但检索无效或包含有害术语的查询，而针对检索奖励的训练仅提供延迟的、序列级别的监督，掩盖了哪些术语有助。我们引入了STORM（基于奖励引导的束搜索逐步令牌优化），一种用于词汇查询扩展的自监督框架。STORM通过检索指标引导的生成来训练重写器：在每一步，候选扩展根据BM25索引进行评分，并剪枝低奖励的延续，将检索奖励转化为逐步反馈。
tldr: STORM提出了一种自监督方法，通过束搜索和检索奖励引导逐步生成查询扩展，将延迟的序列级奖励转化为即时令牌级反馈，以提升词汇检索性能。
en_tdlr: STORM proposes a self-supervised method that uses beam search and retrieval rewards to guide stepwise query expansion, converting delayed sequence-level rewards into immediate token-level feedback for improved lexical retrieval.
